LESSON: THE GIFTS OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.2: The Gifts of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Gifts of the Holy Spirit
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you utilize the gifts of the Holy Spirit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss the teachings of Jesus Christ on the role of the Holy Spirit
2. identify the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit
3. classify the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to their categories
4. read the scripture provided to get knowledge and avoid being lured to false religion or cults
